reading: The sketch is a kanban-style sprint board: a top navigation bar with sprint/search/filter links, two section groups (WEB APP and MOBILE) each starting with a dashed divider and bold caps label, four status columns (To do, In progress, Review, Done) with counts, and a stack of task cards in each column carrying tag badges, titles, avatars, and (for some) progress bars or done/strikethrough styling, all per the typed notes.
